## Key Concepts

sensitivity - of the people who were sick, how many did we catch?
specificity - of the people who were healthy, how many did we correctly leave alone? 

If we reduce our cutoff (ex: 0.30) then sensitivity increases and specificity decreases
IF we increase our cutoff (ex: 0.50) then sensitivity decreases and specificity increases
